prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a finished portrait 2:3 interior illustration for a parchment welcome page in the Paths of Wonder iPhone/iPad storybook. Professional richly textured colored-pencil and graphite crosshatching with fine dark ink contours, detailed physical materials, warm storybook sensibility and confident perspective; not photoreal, not vector, not a childish sketch. Render a cohesive environment vignette, with softly irregular pencil-feathered edges that fade to genuine alpha transparency around the entire scene, 5–8% clear margin, no paper rectangle or black/white background. The illustrated room itself is fully colored and detailed, transparency only outside the vignette. It should feel like the viewer has already stepped into the world, not be a picture of a door or portal. No people, no hero, no hands, no faces/reflections, no characters, no text, labels, typography, logos, borders, frames or book mockups.
Scene: looking into an inviting, well-used garage workshop from just inside the room. A substantial battered wooden workbench sits across the middle distance, with a pale cream retro computer tower, dark cyan monitor showing only small abstract graphs (no lettering), copper wiring and modest blue lights on the right. On the left a charcoal articulated task lamp illuminates a pegboard with recognizable spanners, screwdrivers and pliers, a red metal toolbox, small drawers and salvaged components. A plain steel monkey wrench rests FLAT on the workbench, never standing upright, with no axe blade or futuristic modifications. An unoccupied worn stool and floor-level crates and coiled wire give the foreground depth. The work surface has generous clear working space, not frantic clutter. Warm honey lamplight, muted teal blue and copper accents, worn wood and graphite steel. Late daylight enters from outside the picture; do not show a doorway. Composition: portrait, the full workshop forms an organic illustrated vignette with a clear path into its center. No finished Can Opener gadget, active blade, floating tools, projected shield or later inventions; this is before the hero begins building.

Scene: a quiet, dim, ancient fantasy stone chamber with an EMPTY small summoning circle on its worn flagstone floor. View from just inside the room, looking slightly downward: the circle occupies the lower middle of the portrait composition as an ellipse in perspective. A fine chalk ring and a few restrained geometric chalk markings are worn into the stone. Around the OUTSIDE of the ring stand roughly twelve short ivory candles of irregular used heights with wax drips, each one unmistakably UNLIT: small dark black wicks, NO flames, NO glowing wicks, NO smoke. The circle is empty and dormant, no energy portal, no magic beam. Old rough stone walls curve into shadow behind it; a narrow high window casts a faint cool natural light onto the empty floor and candles. Hints of moss in stone seams, a shallow masonry recess, rich ochre-gray stone with quiet plum and teal shadows. Atmosphere: mysterious but welcoming, expectant and still; enough ambient light to clearly see the candle arrangement on parchment. No ruins exploding, no rubble doorway, no skulls, no scary cult imagery. Portrait composition, clear circular focal point, professional fantasy pencil texture.

Scene: an EMPTY long spaceship corridor made of cold, worn steel, with large rectangular panoramic glass windows along its right wall looking into deep blue-black space densely scattered with small white and amber stars. It is the interior one encounters on arriving aboard, no visible entrance portal. View slightly down the corridor so the steel floor leads into a left-of-center vanishing point while the broad windows fill the right and upper middle. Match handcrafted retro science-fiction book illustration: heavy rounded steel window frames with visible bolts, scuffed ribbed structural supports, inset warm amber light panels beneath the windows, restrained copper pipes and small blue indicator lights, substantial paneled metal floor with subtly reflected blue starlight and amber lamps. Empty and spacious, inviting discovery; no crew, no cockpit chair, no giant planet, no spacecraft battle or world-eater, no holographic UI. Cool blue and graphite steel balanced with warm amber details. Portrait organic vignette; preserve a large clearly visible star view and legible corridor depth, not a rectangular postcard.
